title: An empty Pricing matrices list still shows a sortable header
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin of organization {Organization-A} (for example a newly created test organization) at its location {Location-A}, with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • {Organization-A} has no pricing matrices.
  • You are on a page other than Pricing.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the Pricing matrices tab.
  3. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  4. Look at the Matrix Category column header.
  5. Look at the table body.
  6. Click the Matrix Category column header.
  7. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  8. Look at the Matrix Category column header.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: the Matrix Category header shows an arrow pointing up.
  • Step 5: the table shows its usual empty-table message instead of rows.
  • Step 8: the header still responds as a sortable column: its arrow now points down.
  • Steps 1 to 8: if no organization without pricing matrices can be reached (the default matrix may not be removable), this case cannot be checked by hand. Write 'not checked by hand: no organization without pricing matrices' in the result comment.
